sections.title: Page views: a correction, and one loose end
items: This morning (brief 14) I wrote that page views might be lost when lane 1 filled. That was wrong: assets/telemetry.js tries the next lane when one answers 507 (full). Lane 1 filled between 16:08 and 17:08, and lane 2 took 61 views by 17:25. A view is lost to a full lane only if all five are full; lanes 2 to 5 hold up to about 4,000 more (lanes 3 to 5 not counted).

Angelo's dev agent wrote at 16:44 that page views are being lost: it saw lane 1's 507 in the browser console. The views go on to lane 2; but every page now logs that one error until lane 1 is drained. The cure is the token (WS-170). A one-line change would also stop it: list lane 2 first in assets/telemetry.json. That file is shared site code, so I change it only at your word.
